description:
Registry entry: one row per (document, revision).

Identity (``doc_id``) comes from where the document lives; version (``content_sha256``)
from what it contains; ``revision`` orders a document's history. A delete is a new
revision with ``status='deleted'``, never a missing row.

acl.description: Principals allowed to read the document; inherited by its chunks.
acl.title: Acl

content_sha256.description: Version of the document: SHA-256 of its raw bytes.
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

content_type.description: MIME type of the raw bytes.
content_type.title: Content Type

created_at.description: When this row was written (UTC, timezone-aware). Freshness is computed from it.
created_at.title: Created At

doc_id.description: Stable identity: hash of (source_id, canonical uri). Never changes on edit.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

fetched_at.description: When the connector fetched this version.
fetched_at.title: Fetched At

raw_object_key.description: Object-store key of the raw bytes: raw/{source_id}/{sha[:2]}/{sha}.
raw_object_key.title: Raw Object Key

revision.description: 1-based position in this document's history; a delete is a revision too.
revision.title: Revision

schema_version.description: Version of this row's schema. Bumped on any field change; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

source_id.description: Connector that produced the row, e.g. 'arxiv', 'docs-iceberg', 'tickets'.
source_id.title: Source Id

source_updated_at.description: The source's own modification time, when it exposes one. Drives index lag.
source_updated_at.title: Source Updated At

status.description: Deletes travel as tombstones, never as absence.
status.title: Status

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the row. Every index query and cost report filters on it.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

uri.description: Where the document was fetched from.
uri.title: Uri

title: Document
